extraction_method: Imported actual src/google_data_mcp/server.py and awaited MCPServer.list_tools() locally with mcp 2.3.0 and Pydantic 2.14.1 in an isolated source-local venv; inspected every registration and backing implementation. No tool invocation or Google network request.
limitations: Runtime dependencies are unpinned (mcp>=2.0); recorded schemas reflect mcp 2.3.0/Pydantic 2.14.1. External Google endpoint functionality was not tested.
reason: All seven unconditional tools have complete actual local tool-list schemas, including three implemented Google Trends tools.

tools.name: google_trends_interest
tools.description: Google Trends interest over time for ONE keyword. Values are 0-100 relative WITHIN this single request, so they are not comparable to another call's numbers — use google_trends_compare when you need to rank terms against each other.

geo.description: Country or sub-region code (US, VN, US-CA). Empty = worldwide.
geo.title: Geo

tools.behavior: Fetches explore TIMESERIES and multiline data for one term; returns dates, relative interest and isPartial; caches for 6 hours.
validation_notes: Schema allows empty keyword; TrendsClient rejects an empty/whitespace-only keyword. geo/timeframe are unrestricted strings; listed formats are documentation only.

tools.name: google_trends_compare
tools.description: Compare up to 5 keywords in ONE Google Trends request, so their 0-100 values ARE normalised against each other and can be ranked. Google silently drops a 6th term, so 6+ is refused rather than answered with a term missing.

geo.description: Country or sub-region code. Empty = worldwide.
geo.title: Geo

tools.behavior: Trims and drops empty terms, fetches one shared Trends TIMESERIES comparison, maps values to terms, caches for 6 hours using sorted terms as cache key.
validation_notes: Schema has list[str] without minItems/maxItems. Implementation strips terms, discards empty values and requires 2–5 remaining terms. No uniqueness constraint; duplicate terms overwrite keys in output values. geo/timeframe are unrestricted strings.

tools.name: google_trends_trending
tools.description: What is trending on Google right now in one country. `searchVolume` is Google's own rounded bucket (100000, 1000000), not a precise count.

geo.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, VN, GB.
geo.title: Geo

tools.behavior: Fetches Trending now WIZ batchexecute RPC i0OFE with a fixed 48-hour window; returns term, geo, startedAt and rounded searchVolume; caches full feed for 30 minutes then slices to limit.
validation_notes: limit bounds 1–200 are schema constraints. geo has no country-code pattern or enum; two-letter code is documentary.

tools.name: youtube_listing
tools.description: List videos from YouTube: a channel's Shorts tab, a channel's videos tab, or search results. Returns videoId, title, view count, and (for videos/search) a publish date. Transcripts are NOT available from this server — Google gates them behind a token this server cannot mint.

target.description: A channel (@handle, UC… id or URL) for 'shorts'/'videos'; a search query for 'search'.
target.title: Target

limit.description: Maximum rows. Pagination stops early if the listing runs out.
limit.title: Limit

tools.behavior: Fetches channel Shorts/videos or YouTube search listings and continuation pages up to limit; returns channelInfo and items; caches 3 hours. No transcript tool.
validation_notes: kind enum and limit 1–300 are schema constraints. For channel listings, whitespace-only target raises empty channel; no schema minLength/pattern.

tools.name: google_ads_advertisers
tools.description: Find advertisers in Google's Ads Transparency Center by name. Returns each advertiser's id, country and Google's declared ad count — pass the id to google_ads_creatives.

keyword.description: Advertiser or brand name to search.
keyword.title: Keyword

tools.behavior: Calls Ads Transparency SearchService/SearchSuggestions; returns advertiser names, IDs, countries, declared ad counts and URLs; caches 24 hours.
validation_notes: limit 1–20 is a schema constraint. keyword has no minLength and is not explicitly validated.

tools.name: google_ads_creatives
tools.description: Every ad an advertiser is currently running, from Google's Ads Transparency Center: creative id, format, preview URL and first/last shown dates. An advertiser with zero ads is a real answer — Google keeps advertisers whose ads have stopped running.

advertiser.description: An AR… advertiser id, or a Transparency Center URL containing one.
advertiser.title: Advertiser

tools.behavior: Extracts advertiser AR numeric ID, pages Ads Transparency SearchCreatives in batches of at most 40; returns creative metadata, preview URLs, format and shown dates; caches 12 hours.
validation_notes: limit 1–300 is a schema constraint. Implementation requires AR followed by digits, either alone or as a slash-separated URL component after replacing ? and & with /. No input-schema pattern.

tools.name: google_play_reviews
tools.description: Reviews for an Android app: rating, text, date, app version, thumbs-up and the developer's reply. Reviewer names and avatars are omitted unless you ask for them. Note each language/country returns a DIFFERENT set of reviews, so vary hl/gl to widen coverage.

hl.description: Language code. Each language returns a different set of reviews.
hl.title: Hl

include_author.description: Include the reviewer's display name. Off by default: it is personal data and rarely needed for product or ASO analysis.
include_author.title: Include Author

tools.behavior: Fetches embedded Play app-page reviews and paginates UsvDTd RPC; returns rating, text, date, version, thumbs-up and developer reply, optionally author name; caches 6 hours. The initial page is always the embedded default ordering; sort applies only to subsequent RPC pages.
validation_notes: sort enum and limit 1–400 are schema constraints. app_id/hl/gl have no schema format, pattern or enum. include_author only adds display name; avatars and account IDs remain omitted.
